identity_file.label: Identity files
identity_file.hint: One path per line, tried before ssh-agent.

certificate_file.label: Certificates
certificate_file.hint: One path per line. A key's own -cert.pub is found without being listed.

identities_only.label: Only the identity files
identities_only.hint: Leaves ssh-agent's other keys out, so a server that counts tries isn't used up.

proxy_jump.label: Jump Host
proxy_jump.hint: A saved connection's name or user@host:port, one per line, in the order they are passed.

server_alive_interval.label: Keepalive seconds
server_alive_interval.hint: How often to check the server still answers. 0 turns it off.

host_key_alias.label: Host key alias
host_key_alias.hint: The name to check the host key under, instead of the address.

host_key_algorithms.label: Host key algorithms
host_key_algorithms.hint: As in ~/.ssh/config: +name adds to the defaults, -name removes, ^name puts first.

kex_algorithms.label: Key exchange algorithms
kex_algorithms.hint: As in ~/.ssh/config: +name adds to the defaults, -name removes, ^name puts first.

pubkey_accepted_algorithms.label: Key signature algorithms
pubkey_accepted_algorithms.hint: As in ~/.ssh/config: +name adds to the defaults, -name removes, ^name puts first.

ciphers.label: Ciphers
ciphers.hint: As in ~/.ssh/config: +name adds to the defaults, -name removes, ^name puts first.

macs.label: MACs
macs.hint: As in ~/.ssh/config: +name adds to the defaults, -name removes, ^name puts first.

image_quality.label: Image quality
image_quality.hint: Automatic sends large changes as JPEG and sharpens them once the screen is still.
